description: This file defines a React functional component named 'DisplayOptionsMenu' used for rendering a contextual menu with display preferences (sorting, view options, and other settings) for a note-taking application. It manages preferences state, interacts with application settings, allows toggling options, and renders UI elements like buttons, switches, and menu items.

classes.name: DisplayOptionsMenu
classes.description: A React FunctionComponent that displays a menu for adjusting display preferences of notes, such as sorting, view modes, and visibility toggles, based on user selections and permissions.

methods.name: reloadPreferences
methods.description: Reloads preferences from the application state based on the current mode (global or tag-specific).

methods.name: changeGlobalPreferences
methods.description: Updates global preferences in the application and reloads the preferences.

methods.name: changeSystemViewPreferences
methods.description: Updates preferences specific to a system view tag.

methods.name: changePreferences
methods.description: Handles the logic for updating preferences based on current mode and tag type.

methods.name: resetTagPreferences
methods.description: Resets preferences for the current tag, either system view or user-defined tag.

methods.name: toggleSortReverse
methods.description: Toggles the sort order between ascending and descending.

methods.name: toggleSortBy
methods.description: Sets the sorting property for notes.

methods.name: toggleSortByDateModified
methods.description: Sets sorting by date modified.

methods.name: toggleSortByCreationDate
methods.description: Sets sorting by creation date.

methods.name: toggleSortByTitle
methods.description: Sets sorting by title.

methods.name: toggleHidePreview
methods.description: Toggles the note preview visibility.

methods.name: toggleHideDate
methods.description: Toggles the date display.

methods.name: toggleHideTags
methods.description: Toggles tags visibility.

methods.name: toggleHidePinned
methods.description: Toggles pinned notes visibility.

methods.name: toggleShowArchived
methods.description: Toggles archived notes visibility.

methods.name: toggleShowTrashed
methods.description: Toggles trashed notes visibility.

methods.name: toggleHideProtected
methods.description: Toggles protected notes visibility.

methods.name: toggleEditorIcon
methods.description: Toggles the display of the note editor icon.

methods.name: toggleEntryMode
methods.description: Switches between daily entry mode and normal mode for notes.

methods.name: toggleTableView
methods.description: Switches between list and table view for notes.
